4381-4694-7306-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4381-4694-7306-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

2292-2586-7690--165.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat

1409-5789-8160.description:
Activate Kwia by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kwia enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Lifecreed Duo trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kwia.
Resolve the Lifecreed Duo trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

147-728-4454.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-728-4454.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Bond of Revival.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

575-7084-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control two other nontoken creatures that have base power 1 or greater.
575-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the first additional creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the second creature.
When the second creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the second creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the first creature.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the first and second creature by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the second creature.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the second creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 6.

2178-3817-3899-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
2178-3817-3899-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 5 from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

2730-3175-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

3147-5411-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Azorius Chancery.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Azorius Chancery from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Repeat.

2557-7839-7926.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature or artifact.
Your commander is on the battlefield.
2557-7839-7926.description:
Activate Slag Strider by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens due to Parallel Lives.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

549-2685-3197-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-2685-3197-6824.description:
Gain life in any way.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

4222-6006-7734.description:
Activate Wakandan Tusker by tapping it, adding {U}.
Wakandan Tusker triggers, causing you to scry 1 and gain 1 life
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Wakandan Tusker.
Repeat.

193-1124-2724-3217.description:
Activate Aminatou's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Activate Aminatou's second ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-5434-7659.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5434-7659.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Brimaz as attackers.
Brimaz triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2604-5639-7070.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken colorless creature.
You have one or fewer cards in hand.
2604-5639-7070.description:
Activate Arm-Mounted Anchor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting the colorless creature.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the creature.
Arm-Mounted Anchor's ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Ugin.
Repeat.

3175-4775-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1558-2097-3861-3875-4231.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Jolene.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

147-5147-7166.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5147-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-5147-7166.notes: Perform this combo during your main phase to prevent Dose of Dawnglow from causing you to blight.

3165-3375-3532-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3165-3375-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

5256-5751-6462-7104-7105.description:
Cast Tower Winder from your graveyard by paying {1}{G} and discarding Command Tower
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When Tower Winder enters, it triggers, returning Command Tower from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Tower Winder.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1170-1329-4708-4927.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard.
Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2854-4211-4574-5849.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2854-4211-4574-5849.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

3542-3647-4863.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
3542-3647-4863.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Revolutionist and Palinchron
When Revolutionist and Palinchron enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
3542-3647-4863.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Palinchron.

4593-4659-6291-6458.easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
4593-4659-6291-6458.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating a 1/1 Thopter and a 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token.
When the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter enter, Thunder of Unity triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life and each opponent to lose 2 life.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
4593-4659-6291-6458.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and/or Thopter

1445-2279-4871-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2279-4871-6798.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

567-2919-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-2919-4186.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3372-4890-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Dack's Duplicate
3372-4890-5466.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Rakdos Joins Up to become a creature.
Cast Dack's Duplicate by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Dack's Duplicate into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Dack's Duplicate's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Dack's Duplicate's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Dack's Duplicate's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 3.

1354-1835-4275-4772.notablePrerequisites: Zaxara does not have summoning sickness.
1354-1835-4275-4772.description:
Activate Zaxara by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying {2}{G}{G}.
Zaxara triggers, creating two 0/0 Hydra creature tokens.
The Hydras enter the battlefield and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Faces of the Past trigger twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all Hydras.
Activate Zaxara by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the second Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Hydras.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating a 0/0 Wurm creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
The Wurm enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the Wurm dies, Faces of the Past triggers, either tapping or untapping all Wurms.
Repeat.

64-500-2081.description:
Cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing another creature, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Warden of the Eye and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Warden of the Eye tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Culling the Weak from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1003-1329-2178-2292.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1003-1329-2178-2292.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1741-2092-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1} if Agatha has power 2 or greater, or {2} otherwise.
1741-2092-4499.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying at most {2}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.
1741-2092-4499.notes: If Agatha has power 2 or greater, you'll only pay {1} in step 2, and can net mana from the second land.

1844-3140-6085.notablePrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 7.
1844-3140-6085.description:
Cast Fateful Handoff by paying {3}{B}, causing you to draw seven cards and give control of Altanak to an opponent.
Activate Soltari Guerrillas an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Altanak.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

1909-4486-5986.notablePrerequisites: Whisperer of the Wilds does not have summoning sickness. You control a creature with power 4 or greater who has at least a +3/+3 boost from secondary effects.
1909-4486-5986.description:
Activate Whisperer of the Wilds by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Whisperer of the Wilds.
Repeat.

457-3003-3263-4659-5341.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional artifacts for each time you've cast The Cyber-Controller from the command zone this game.
NOTE: This combo may fail if the opponents do not mill any creature cards. Having additional artifacts on the battlefield and/or mana available help mitigate this.
457-3003-3263-4659-5341.description:
Activate Urza's first ability three times by tapping three artifacts you control, adding {3}.
Cast The Cyber-Controller from the command zone, choosing for X to equal the amount of artifacts you control minus twice the number of times The Cyber-Controller has been cast from the command zone this game, but paying a total of {3} due to Mycosynth Lattice and Mycosynth Golem.
When The Cyber-Controller enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to mill X cards, and then putting all creature cards milled this way onto the battlefield face down under your control as 2/2 Cyberman artifact creatures.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping The Cyber-Controller, adding {1}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing The Cyber-Controller, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return The Cyber-Controller to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2 as able, or until each opponent has milled their library.

654-3177-3756-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Sakura-Tribe Scout does not have summoning sickness.
654-3177-3756-4222.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger from step 2, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Repeat.

372-2719-5083.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
372-2719-5083.description:
Cast Sakashima of a Thousand Faces either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Sakashima of a Thousand Faces leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Icy Prison returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Icy Prison enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Icy Prison until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Icy Prison leaves the battlefield, its third ability triggers, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces to the battlefield from exile as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

1068-2799-4659.description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
When Leveler enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to exile your library.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Leveler, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Lembas by paying {2}.
When Lembas enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lembas, adding {C}{C}.
Lembas' third ability triggers, shuffling it into your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Lembas trigger from step 5, causing you to scry 1 and draw Lembas from the top of your library.
Repeat from step 4.

1723-1946-2512.description:
Activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, causing itself to get +0/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Starlit Sanctum's second ability by paying {W}, tapping it and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

1379-4050-4375-4681.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Technomancer enters the battlefield.
In response to its trigger, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Technomancer, adding {1}.
Resolve Technomancer's trigger, milling three cards and returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, returning Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Technomancer enters the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Technomancer and Karmic Guide, adding {2}.
Repeat from step 4.

586-864-2267-3125-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2267-3125-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Tormod.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

1512-2120.notablePrerequisites:
Wanderwine Prophets and Stonybrook Schoolmaster do not have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block creatures you control.
1512-2120.description:
Attack with Wanderwine Prophets and Stonybrook Schoolmaster.
Stonybrook Schoolmaster triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk Wizard token.
Wanderwine Prophets deals combat damage, sacrificing the Merfolk token.
You get an extra turn.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
